description: Add products to the user's MyGroceryPal shopping list, so they can open it in the app or on the web, and get deal alerts on saved products the way their MyGroceryPal notification settings say. Only adds: a product already on the list is left as it is. Needs the user's MyGroceryPal account.

productId.description: A productId returned by price_shopping_list or search_grocery_prices

store.description: The store the user plans to buy these at, if one

name: save_shopping_list
title: Save a list to MyGroceryPal
